alt: 孩子讀到有趣的繪本，忍不住捂嘴大笑，旁邊的朋友驚訝地看著他。
scene_prompt: In a quiet library a child reading a funny picture book suddenly bursts into delighted uncontrollable laughter, one hand reflexively covering the open smiling mouth, shoulders lifted in a giggle. A friend beside them looks surprised then amused. The open page shows only a simple funny original puppy drawing without writing. Focus on spontaneous emotion impossible to suppress, not deliberate performance.
